title: Compass Sport Qualifier
text:
From our Team Captain, Sarah:

The results are now up for the Compass Sport Qualifier held at Hatfield Forest at the weekend. Thanks to all our competitors who were able to attend this postponed event - after the final number-crunching we came a very respectable second, only 22 points behind the winning team from SOS. Congratulations to our 4 class winners: Barney, Tim, Will and Sarah. A summary of the SuffOC team's results can be found here.
